links.to_node: I prevent the colleague's experiment from being conducted.
The laboratory's main computer system undergoes a mandatory system upgrade.
Other ongoing research projects experience delays due to the system upgrade.
The potential breakthrough in cancer research from the colleague's experiment does not occur at this time.
Data that could have contributed to new cancer treatment development is not obtained from the prevented experiment.
